title: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2610.17670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cowork agents navigate dependencies across tools and files while adapting to changing user requirements and edits to shared workspaces. Scaling such environments requires maintaining consistency among task objectives, executable resources, user behavior, and success criteria. We introduce Cowork-Gym, a framework that synthesizes Cowork environments through a build-execute-revise loop that uses execution evidence and review feedback to validate and repair generated environments. To capture realistic Cowork dynamics, a stateful user simulator responds to the agent's actions through dialogue and direct edits to the shared workspace. We synthesize 64.9K environments across 14 application scenarios and use them to post-train 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B Qwen models with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation. Averaged across six agentic benchmarks, these models outperform their corresponding base checkpoints by 8.7

translated_title: Cowork-Gym：大规模合成交互式工作环境
translated_abstract: Cowork智能体需要在工具与文件之间穿梭处理依赖关系，同时适应不断变化的用户需求以及对共享工作区的编辑。要对此类环境进行规模化扩展，就必须在任务目标、可执行资源、用户行为和成功标准之间保持一致性。我们提出了Cowork-Gym，一个通过“构建-执行-修订”循环来合成Cowork环境的框架，该循环利用执行证据和审查反馈来验证并修复生成的环境。为了捕捉真实的Cowork动态，一个有状态的用户模拟器会通过对话以及对共享工作区的直接编辑来响应智能体的行为。我们在14个应用场景中合成了6.49万个环境，并利用监督微调、强化学习和在线策略蒸馏，用这些环境对9B、27B和35B-A3B的Qwen模型进行后训练。在六个智能体基准测试中取平均，这些模型的表现比对应的基础模型检查点高出8.7个百分点（原文此处数据似有截断）。
tldr: Cowork-Gym提出了一种通过“构建-执行-修订”循环结合有状态用户模拟器，大规模自动合成并修复交互式工作环境（14个场景共6.49万个）的框架，并用这些环境后训练Qwen模型，使其在六个智能体基准上平均超越基础模型8.7个百分点。
en_tdlr: Cowork-Gym synthesizes interactive work environments at scale (64.9K across 14 scenarios) via a build-execute-revise loop with a stateful user simulator, and post-training Qwen models on them yields an average 8.7-point improvement across six agentic benchmarks.
